agents.name: Data Aggregator
agents.purpose: Collects and displays student data from various systems for instructor review.
agents.trigger: Instructor logs in via Student Portal

agents.name: Report Generator
agents.purpose: Generates a weekly report of students potentially falling behind.

agents.name: Review Facilitator
agents.purpose: Facilitates instructor review and approval of the weekly report.
escalation_rules: If instructor does not approve, report is not sent

agents.name: Email Notifier
agents.purpose: Sends emails to instructors with suggested messages for students.
escalation_rules: If report is not approved, emails are not sent

agents.name: Integrity Checker
agents.purpose: Ensures data integrity and logs instructor actions for audit purposes.
agents.trigger: Any data processing or instructor action
approval_gates: REQ-011 — The system must ensure data integrity and accuracy in reports.

agents.name: Analytics Provider
agents.purpose: Provides analytics on student engagement trends and allows report customization.

stories.title: Enable instructors to log in via Student Portal and access their dashboard
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to log in using the Student Portal credentials, so that I can access my dashboard securely.
acceptance: Given an instructor with valid Student Portal credentials, when they log in, then they should access their dashboard.
Given an instructor with invalid credentials, when they attempt to log in, then they should receive an error message.
Trust: Every login attempt must be recorded in the audit log.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate with the Student Portal API to authenticate instructors and redirect them to their dashboard upon successful login.

stories.title: Display student progress data on instructor dashboard
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to view student progress data on my dashboard, so that I can monitor their performance.
acceptance: Given an instructor logged into the dashboard, when they view a student's profile, then they should see the progress data.
Given an instructor views a student with no progress data, when they access the profile, then they should see a 'No data available' message.
Trust: Access to student progress data must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Fetch progress data from the LMS and display it on the instructor's dashboard.

stories.title: Show attendance data on instructor dashboard
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to see student attendance data, so that I can track their participation.
acceptance: Given an instructor logged into the dashboard, when they view a student's attendance, then they should see the attendance records.
Given an instructor views a student with no attendance records, when they access the profile, then they should see a 'No attendance data available' message.
Trust: Access to attendance data must be logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate with the Attendance Tracking System to fetch and display attendance data on the dashboard.

stories.title: Generate basic weekly report
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to generate a basic weekly report, so that I can review student progress.
acceptance: Given the instructor is logged in, when they navigate to the reports section, then they can generate a basic weekly report.
Given the instructor is not logged in, when they attempt to access the reports section, then they are prompted to log in.
Trust: All report generation actions are logged for audit purposes.
failure_paths: Report generation fails due to missing data.
Instructor attempts to generate a report without permissions.
System fails to log the report generation action.
stories.task_guidance: Implement report generation using the existing data sources and ensure logging of actions in the audit trail.

stories.title: Enable instructor review of reports
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to review the list of students before emails are sent, so that I can ensure accuracy.
acceptance: Given a report is generated, when an instructor reviews it, then they can approve or modify the list.
Given a student is incorrectly flagged, when the instructor reviews the report, then they can correct the error.
Trust: Ensure all changes by instructors are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Create a review interface for instructors to approve or modify the student list before sending.

stories.title: Flag uncertain recommendations for review
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to flag uncertain student recommendations for instructor review, so that instructors can make the final decision.
acceptance: Given a student recommendation is uncertain, when the report is generated, then the student is flagged for review.
Given a flagged student is reviewed, when the instructor approves, then the student is included in the final list.
Trust: Ensure all flagged recommendations are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a flagging mechanism for uncertain recommendations in the report generation module.

stories.title: Send emails with suggested messages
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to send emails with suggested opening lines, so that instructors can easily communicate with students.
acceptance: Given the instructor approves the list, when emails are sent, then each email includes a suggested opening line.
Given an email fails to send, when the system retries, then the email is successfully sent.
Trust: Ensure all sent emails are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate with the Email Platform to send emails. Use the 'email_content' table for storing suggested messages.

stories.title: Implement data integrity checks
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to ensure data integrity, so that reports are accurate and reliable.
acceptance: Given data is pulled from external systems, when it is stored, then integrity checks ensure accuracy.
Given a data integrity issue is detected, when the report is generated, then an alert is raised.
Trust: Ensure all integrity checks are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop integrity check routines for data storage processes.

stories.title: Log instructor actions for audit
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to log all instructor actions, so that there is an audit trail of changes and approvals.
acceptance: Given an instructor approves a report, when the action is logged, then it is stored in the audit log.
Given an instructor modifies a report, when the action is logged, then it is stored in the audit log.
Trust: Ensure all logs are secure and tamper-proof.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logging for all instructor actions in the 'audit_log' table.

stories.title: Provide analytics on student engagement trends
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to see analytics on student engagement trends, so that I can better understand student behavior over time.
acceptance: Given historical data is available, when analytics are generated, then trends are displayed accurately.
Given a trend is incorrect, when the data is reviewed, then the error is identified.
Trust: Ensure analytics data is accurate and up-to-date.
stories.task_guidance: Develop an analytics dashboard using data from 'student_activity', 'student_progress', and 'student_attendance' tables.

stories.title: Allow customization of report criteria
stories.narrative: As an instructor, I want to customize report criteria, so that I can tailor reports to my needs.
acceptance: Given a customization option is available, when an instructor modifies it, then the report reflects the changes.
Given a customization error occurs, when the report is generated, then an alert is raised.
Trust: Ensure all customizations are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement customization options in the report generation module.

stories.title: Establish audit trail for all instructor actions
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to ensure all instructor actions are logged, so that we maintain a complete audit trail.
acceptance: Given an instructor performs any action on the system, when the action is completed, then it should be logged in the audit trail.
Given an instructor attempts an unauthorized action, when the attempt is made, then it should be logged in the audit trail.
Trust: The audit trail must be immutable and accessible for review.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logging for all instructor actions and ensure logs are stored securely and are tamper-proof.

descriptor: A tool to identify and notify instructors about students who may be falling behind, using data from various educational systems.

requirements.statement: The system must read student login data from the Student Portal.
The system must read student progress data from the Learning Management System.
The system must read attendance data from the Attendance Tracking System.
The system must send emails via the Email Platform.
The system must generate a weekly report of students potentially falling behind based on login, progress, and attendance data.
The system must allow instructors to review and approve the list of students before emails are sent.
The system must provide suggested opening lines for each student in the report.
The system must flag students for instructor review if the recommendation is uncertain.
The system must send the final approved list to instructors every Monday morning.
The system must allow instructors to view activity data for each student in the report.
The system must ensure data integrity and accuracy in reports.
The system must log all actions taken by instructors for audit purposes.
Every instructor-facing screen must allow completion of its primary action in three clicks or fewer.
The system should optimize email content for engagement.
The system should provide analytics on student engagement trends over time.
The system should allow customization of report criteria by instructors.
The system should support multiple languages for email content.
The system should provide mobile access to reports.
